```{r download_data}

if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  options(download.file.method = "wininet")
} else {
  options(download.file.method = "curl")
}
options(timeout = 1200)


re2g_url  <- "[https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF202FID/@@download/ENCFF202FID.bed.gz](https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF202FID/@@download/ENCFF202FID.bed.gz)"
tf_url    <- "[https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF566CTX/@@download/ENCFF566CTX.bed.gz](https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF566CTX/@@download/ENCFF566CTX.bed.gz)"
prom_url  <- "[https://ethz-ins.org/content/hgEns104.promoters.rds](https://ethz-ins.org/content/hgEns104.promoters.rds)"

re2g_file <- "re2g_links.bed"
tf_file   <- "tf_peaks.bed"          # Adjusted to match your unzipped file
prom_file <- "promoters.rds"


download_safe <- function(url, dest) {
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    message(paste("Attempting download for:", dest))
    tryCatch({
      download.file(url, destfile = dest)
    }, error = function(e) {
      stop(paste0(
        "\n\n[FILE MISSING] The file '", dest, "' was not found in your directory.\n",
        "Please ensure you have moved your browser-downloaded file to this folder,\n",
        "and that it is named exactly: '", dest, "'\n\n"
      ))
    })
  } else {
    message(paste("File successfully found locally, skipping download:", dest))
  }
}


download_safe(re2g_url, re2g_file)
download_safe(tf_url, tf_file)
download_safe(prom_url, prom_file)

cat("Data verification successful! Proceeding to processing.\n")
```
```{r parse_and_map}
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(GenomicRanges)


proms <- readRDS("promoters.rds")
seqlevelsStyle(proms) <- "ensembl"

peaks <- rtracklayer::import("tf_peaks.bed", format = "narrowPeak")
seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "ensembl"


re2g_df <- read.table("re2g_links.bed", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


re2g <- GRanges(
  seqnames = re2g_df$V1,
  ranges = IRanges(start = re2g_df$V2, end = re2g_df$V3)
)
seqlevelsStyle(re2g) <- "ensembl"


re2g$gene_target <- re2g_df$V6

o <- findOverlaps(peaks, re2g)

mcols(peaks)$target <- CharacterList(vector("list", length(peaks)))
mcols(peaks)[from(o), "target"] <- re2g$gene_target[to(o)]

peaks_with_targets <- peaks[lengths(peaks$target) > 0]
cat("Found", length(peaks_with_targets), "peaks with active rE2G loops.\n")
```

```{r trouble shooting}

cat("Am I in the right folder?", file.exists("re2g_links.bed"), "\n")

cat("File size in bytes:", file.info("re2g_links.bed")$size, "\n")
```
```{r analysis}

peaks_expanded <- rep(peaks_with_targets, lengths(peaks_with_targets$target))
mcols(peaks_expanded)$single_target <- unlist(peaks_with_targets$target)

unique_proms <- proms[!duplicated(proms$gene_name)]

target_match <- match(peaks_expanded$single_target, unique_proms$gene_name)

valid_rows <- !is.na(target_match)
peaks_expanded <- peaks_expanded[valid_rows]
target_proms <- unique_proms[target_match[valid_rows]]

peak_centers <- start(peaks_expanded) + width(peaks_expanded)/2
tss_positions <- start(target_proms) + width(target_proms)/2
is_downstream_genomic <- peak_centers > tss_positions

peaks_expanded$direction <- ifelse(
  as.character(strand(target_proms)) == "-",
  ifelse(is_downstream_genomic, "upstream", "downstream"),
  ifelse(is_downstream_genomic, "downstream", "upstream")
)

peaks_expanded$target_distance <- distance(peaks_expanded, target_proms)

nearest_all <- distanceToNearest(peaks_expanded, unique_proms)
peaks_expanded$closest_gene <- unique_proms$gene_name[subjectHits(nearest_all)]
peaks_expanded$is_closest <- peaks_expanded$single_target == peaks_expanded$closest_gene

upstream_set <- peaks_expanded[peaks_expanded$direction == "upstream"]
downstream_set <- peaks_expanded[peaks_expanded$direction == "downstream"]

prop_up <- mean(upstream_set$is_closest, na.rm=TRUE) * 100
prop_down <- mean(downstream_set$is_closest, na.rm=TRUE) * 100

cat(sprintf("Proportion where the UPSTREAM 3D target is the closest gene: %.2f%%\n", prop_up))
cat(sprintf("Proportion where the DOWNSTREAM 3D target is the closest gene: %.2f%%\n", prop_down))
```

```{r plotting}
ggplot(as.data.frame(peaks_expanded), aes(x = target_distance, fill = direction)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("upstream" = "#2980b9", "downstream" = "#e67e22")) +
  labs(
    title = "Genomic Distance: MYC Peaks to rE2G Target Promoters",
    subtitle = "Stratified by relative structural topology",
    x = "Distance to target TSS (bp, log10 scale)",
    y = "Density Profiles",
    fill = "Peak Position"
  )
```
